metadata.title: Dynamical evolution of star-forming regions: III. Unbound stars and predictions for Gaia

notes: No eligible stars. HD 46223 and HD 46106 are mentioned at T:p15-b4 only through Wareing et al.'s NGC 2244 study; the ejection suggestion is described as uncertain, the 1.38 km s−1 proper-motion velocity is far below the walkaway threshold, and HD 46223 is said to be possibly still bound to the cluster. This is neither a retained Galactic-unbound candidacy nor a follow-up of a previously identified Galactic-unbound candidate. The simulations' unbound objects are unnamed statistical populations unbound from their star-forming regions, not individually identifiable Galactic-unbound stars.
